questions.q: Value Added Tax (VAT) is fundamentally characterized as a/an
options: Direct tax levied on the personal income and profits of individuals
Multi-stage indirect consumption tax levied on the value added at each stage of the supply chain
Single-stage sales tax collected strictly at the final retail point of sale
Capital gains tax charged exclusively on the disposal of non-current business assets
questions.explain: **Value Added Tax (VAT)** is a multi-stage indirect tax on consumption. It is collected incrementally at every stage of the production and distribution chain whenever value is added, but the ultimate economic burden is borne by the final consumer.
